name: Are there grants or financial assistance programs for accessible kitchen remodels?

mainEntity.name: Are there grants or financial assistance programs for accessible kitchen remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there may be various grants and financial assistance programs available for accessible home modifications, including kitchen remodels. These can include federal programs like HUD's Section 504 Home Repair program, state and local programs, or non-profit organizations focused on independent living. Veterans may also qualify for VA benefits for home adaptations. Eligibility requirements vary significantly by program. It's recommended to research local and national resources or consult with an occupational therapist for guidance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, grants and assistance programs from federal, state, local, or non-profit sources may be available for accessible kitchen remodels.
